questions.q: What are the tax filing deadlines?
questions.a: For most individuals, the federal tax filing deadline is April 15. Extensions may be available depending on your situation.

questions.q: Can you help if I am close to or past a deadline?
questions.a: Yes. If you are approaching a deadline or are already late, options may still be available. That can include extensions, late filings or corrective filings depending on the circumstances.

questions.q: Do I need to have all my documents ready before scheduling?
questions.a: No. You do not need to have everything prepared before our initial call. The purpose of the call is to understand your situation and outline next steps.

process.title: What to expect
process.text: Timelines can vary based on complexity, document completeness and time of year.

steps.title: Schedule a brief call
steps.text: A short conversation to understand your situation, timeline and filing needs. The introductory call is free, and you do not need to have all documents ready at this stage.

steps.title: Fee quote and engagement
steps.text: A fee quote and an engagement letter setting out the scope of work. Work begins once the engagement is signed and the initial installment is in.

steps.title: Secure document upload
steps.text: You receive access to encrypted ShareFile to upload your tax documents. Documents should not be emailed.

steps.title: Preparation and review
steps.text: I prepare your return from the information provided, and follow up if anything needs clarification. Requests for additional documents may extend the timeline, depending on the complexity of the return and how quickly they come back.

steps.title: Final payment and filing
steps.text: The remaining balance is due before e-filing. Once it is received the return is filed and a copy is provided in the client portal.

about.title: An Enrolled Agent who works on tax and nothing else.
text: I'm Jessica Allyn, an Enrolled Agent licensed to practice before the Internal Revenue Service. An Enrolled Agent is a federally authorized tax professional permitted to prepare tax returns and represent taxpayers before the IRS, and Enrolled Agents specialize exclusively in taxation, compliance and IRS matters.

I graduated from Eastern Connecticut State University and have worked in tax preparation and compliance since 2019, assisting individuals and business owners with accurate filings, prior-year returns and more complex tax situations.

I specialize in individual and small business tax preparation, with a focus on helping clients understand how income structure, entity classification and tax elections affect their filings and ongoing compliance obligations. My goal is to provide thorough, accurate returns while remaining available to answer questions throughout the process, from engagement through filing.

faqs.q: Do I need to have all my documents ready before scheduling?
faqs.a: No. You do not need to have everything prepared before our initial call. The purpose of the call is to understand your situation and outline next steps.

faqs.q: When will I receive a pricing quote?
faqs.a: After our initial call, or after reviewing your pricing form responses, I will provide a non-binding fee estimate by the next business day.

Tax preparation fees vary based on the type of return and overall complexity. Because every tax situation is different, I prefer to provide a personalized quote after reviewing your information, and all fees are quoted and agreed upon prior to preparation.

Appointments are held via Google Meet, and a meeting link is sent automatically after scheduling. I recommend joining from a computer or laptop. If you prefer a phone call, leave a note when scheduling and I will be happy to accommodate.

faqs.q: How do I submit my tax documents?
faqs.a: For security reasons, tax documents should not be emailed or uploaded prior to engagement. Once we begin working together, I will provide access to encrypted ShareFile for secure document upload.

faqs.q: Can you file an extension for me?
faqs.a: Extensions may be available if sufficient information is provided before the deadline. This can be discussed during our initial call.
